newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pre-Paid buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pre-Paid buy repeated.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc said on Friday it reiterated its strong buy and $34 per share 12-month price target on the shares of Pre-Paid Legal Services Inc.
-- Analyst David Strasser said in a research note issues related to commission advances had existed for some time in the investment community and were somewhat overblown.
-- "The company, in spite of its strategy to pay commission advances, still generates positive operating cash flow," Strasser said.
-- Strasser also said he believed the company was close to signing an agreement with an insurance company to distribute its product, which would increase both its credibility and sales force.
